title: Flexible Snapchat Ads Pricing | Reach Your Target Audience

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page states that ads can be run with a minimum spend of $5 per day.
facts.quote: You can spend as little as $5 a day, but we recommend at least $20-50 per day to help your ad complete the Exploration Phase

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page recommends spending at least $20-50 per day so the ad can complete the Exploration Phase.
facts.quote: we recommend at least $20-50 per day to help your ad complete the Exploration Phase

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page says new advertisers receive $75 in free ad credit after spending $50.
facts.quote: we’ll give you $75 in free ad credit when you spend $50.

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page says the spend threshold for the $75 free ad credit offer is $50.
facts.quote: we’ll give you $75 in free ad credit when you spend $50.

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page states the Exploration Phase typically lasts 4 days or more, depending on the campaign objective.
facts.quote: typically 4 days or more, depending on your campaign objective

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page says advertisers can set and manage daily and lifetime spend limits.
Snapchat's vendor page says advertisers can start and stop their ads at any time.
facts.quote: can start and stop your ads any time.

facts.fact: Snapchat's vendor page says advertisers see estimates of reach and results based on the amount they want to spend when setting up an ad.
facts.quote: you can see estimates of reach and results based on how much you want to spend.
